review.assumptionsToDischarge: For the original holomorphic principal-level function with finite cusp poles at every modular translate, derive a literal Laurent representation in the ordinary complex span of elements of the original cyclotomic j/Fricke field integral over its j-algebra. Actual modular-orbit fraction and monic relation are consumed. Generator integrality, finiteness, cyclotomic coefficients, j transcendence, complex fraction membership and all constant-descent premises are derived.
review.remaining: The formal Laurent integral-span stage is proved for the actual function. Recover holomorphic functions for the integral Laurent summands, establish pole-cleared cyclotomic Fourier coefficients and rational Fourier spanning, then arbitrary Gamma1 differential realization and the remaining arithmetic association, automorphy and higher continuation chain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
review.shorterRouteReview: Reuse the native finite-action monic polynomial instead of constructing a separate exact-degree Fricke orbit polynomial. Existing analytic Laurent representation and coefficient retraction give generator integrality. Native integral-equation transport maps it back to the original constant algebra. Reuse the already proved expanded-j transcendence; the alternate analytic fraction-field j-transcendence result is not needed on this Laurent route. The existing meromorphic germ identity handles denominator zeros. For the next holomorphic-recovery step, local SourceHolomorphicQuotientExtension and SourceMonicRelationRootBound already provide removable singularities and the monic-root bound, so importing the external general analytic quotient/valuation engine is unnecessary.
